{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
# 1 & 2: listing
if [ -d /working ]; then
  find /working -print > temp_workspace/listing.txt
else
  : > temp_workspace/listing.txt
fi
# 3: candidates whose basename is exactly "workspace"
awk -F'/' '$NF=="workspace"{print}' temp_workspace/listing.txt > temp_workspace/candidates.txt
# 4: metadata for each candidate
: > temp_workspace/metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    stat -c '%n|%F|%s|%A|%U|%G|%Y|%i|%d' -- "$p" >> temp_workspace/metadata.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "$p|stat_failed" >> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
  else
    echo "$p|missing" >> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt
# 5: retain only regular files
awk -F'|' '$2=="regular file"{print $1}' temp_workspace/metadata.txt > temp_workspace/regulars.txt
# 6: confirm each regular is within /working
: > temp_workspace/verified.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  case "$p" in
    /working/*) echo "$p|ok" >> temp_workspace/verified.txt;;
    *) echo "$p|not_within_working" >> temp_workspace/verified.txt;;
  esac
done < temp_workspace/regulars.txt
# 7: find duplicates (by canonical path) and choose primary
: > temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
: > temp_workspace/_canon_map.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  # only consider verified ok entries
  grep -Fxq "$p|ok" temp_workspace/verified.txt || continue
  canon=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || realpath -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "$p")
  printf '%s|%s\n' "$canon" "$p" >> temp_workspace/_canon_map.txt
done < temp_workspace/regulars.txt
# record duplicates: if same canonical path appears >1, list original paths
awk -F'|' '{count[$1]++; arr[$1]=arr[$1] $2 "\n"} END{for(k in count) if(count[k]>1){split(arr[k],a,"\n"); for(i in a) if(a[i]!="") print a[i]}}' temp_workspace/_canon_map.txt > temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
# primary: first canonical path in map (if any)
primary=$(awk -F'|' 'NR==1{print $1; exit}' temp_workspace/_canon_map.txt || true)
if [ -n "$primary" ]; then
  echo "$primary" > temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
else
  : > temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
fi
# 8: remove intermediate files not part of final candidate or verification logs
rm -f temp_workspace/candidates.txt temp_workspace/regulars.txt temp_workspace/_canon_map.txt
# 9: consistency check
fc=$(sed -n '1p' temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt)
if [ -z "$fc" ]; then
  echo "no_final_candidate" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
else
  grep -Fxq "$fc" temp_workspace/listing.txt && inlist=yes || inlist=no
  grep -Fq "$fc" temp_workspace/metadata.txt && inmeta=yes || inmeta=no
  if [ "$inlist" = yes ] && [ "$inmeta" = yes ]; then
    echo "consistent" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
  else
    echo "inconsistent listing:$inlist metadata:$inmeta" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
  fi
fi
# 10: readiness summary (one line)
if grep -Fq '|ok' temp_workspace/verified.txt; then
  echo "exists: yes" > temp_workspace/ready.txt
else
  echo "exists: no" > temp_workspace/ready.txt
fi
# final output to assistant: yes if a verified regular file named "workspace" under /working exists
if grep -Fq '|ok' temp_workspace/verified.txt; then
  printf 'yes'
else
  printf 'no'
fi
"}
